# Tearsheet

## Tearsheet

The wide tearsheet: a bottom-anchored layer with a header (label, heading,
description, optional navigation), an optional influencer panel, the main
content and a row of actions. Composes the focus-trap, layer-space,
overlay, reduced-motion and viewport-layer behaviors; Heading, IconButton
and Button draw the parts.

- The container is `tearsheet_inset_inline` from each side and `inset_top`
  (`_lower` under `verticalPosition: 'lower'`) from the top of the layer
  space, bottom-anchored, with the dialog's border cells on every side.
- The header's `minHeight` is `tearsheet_header_height` (a floor); its
  padding is the block / inline cells, `header_padding_end` when the close
  button sits there, bottom 0 with navigation.
- `hasCloseIcon` defaults to passive (no actions); the close button is the
  IconButton at `icon_button_size` with the dialog's close glyph size.
- Actions order ghost -> secondary -> primary; each seat is a quarter of
  the action row capped at `action_max_width`, a ghost takes the rest on
  the left. One element paints `tearsheet_actions_container` and the top
  rule; the button container wraps it transparent, as upstream's Wrap.
- Initial focus: the close button when drawn (passive or `hasCloseIcon`),
  else the first action button. Outside press closes only when passive.
- Enter: from `min(0.95 x layer height, tearsheet_enter_offset)` below over
  `motion.duration_moderate_02`; reduced motion and measurement draw at
  rest.
- Stacking: the host's open layers named `Tearsheet` form the stack, at
  most 3; a level below the top scales `(w - 32 * d) / w` and grows its
  max height `tearsheet_stack_offset` per level. Unhosted: no stack.

## Tearsheet

Tearsheet is a large dialog for a focused task: a header, an optional influencer panel, the main content and a row of actions.

| Tier | `composite` |
| Platform | `both` |

| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | yes | Whether the tearsheet shows. The caller owns the state; `onClose` asks for a close. |
| `onClose` | `function` | no | Called on Escape, the close button and a passive tearsheet's outside press. Returning `false` vetoes the close. |
| `label` | `string` | no | The eyebrow label above the title. |
| `title` | `string` | no | The heading text; names the dialog when `accessibilityLabel` is not given. |
| `description` | `string` | no | Supporting text under the heading, capped at the description share of the header width. |
| `navigation` | `node` | no | A navigation block under the header text. |
| `headerActions` | `node` | no | Extra actions beside the header. |
| `hasCloseIcon` | `boolean` | no | Draws the close button. Default: a tearsheet with no actions (passive). |
| `closeIconDescription` | `string` | no | The close button's accessible name. Default `Close`. |
| `influencer` | `node` | no | A side panel inside the body. |
| `influencerPosition` | `string` | no | One of `left`, `right`. Left spans the body height beside main; right sits inside main above the action row. Default `left`. |
| `influencerWidth` | `string` | no | One of `narrow`, `wide`. Default `narrow`. |
| `actions` | `array` | no | Action buttons `[{ label, kind, onPress, disabled }]`, kind one of `ghost`, `secondary`, `primary`, `danger`. Order drawn: ghost, secondary, primary. |
| `verticalPosition` | `string` | no | One of `normal`, `lower`: the container's top inset. Default `normal`. |
| `children` | `node` | no | The main content. |
| `returnFocusRef` | `object` | no | Ref of the launcher; focused when the tearsheet closes. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string` | no | Accessible name; the title names the dialog when this is not given. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the container. |
